output.summary: Clump-forming perennial herb native to China’s Shanxi Province. It has flat leaves with a garlic-like flavour and round clusters of white flowers. The leaves, stalks and unopened flower buds are used in cooking, including as flavouring and in stir-fries and dumplings.
output.edibilityNote: Leaves, stalks and unopened flower buds are eaten; leaves may also be blanched, and flowers are fermented into sauce.
